messages.subject: Order L-40271 Exchange
messages.text:
Hello,

 

 
I have just received my order of a Lasclay jacket and I would like to know if it possible to exchange it due to the size.

 

 
I ordered a Men's Milkweed-insulated Jacket, color Black, in size L but it does not fit as well as I would like and so I would like to exchange it for a size XL. Order number L-40271.

 
 

 
I see on your website that there is a $9.99 CAD surcharge for returns and I have no problem paying it, as it was my error.

 

 
Can you please tell me what steps I need to take to perform the exchange?

 

 
Sincerely,

 

 
 
Joseph Arciresi

messages.subject: Re: Order L-40271 Exchange
messages.text:
Hello Joseph,
 

 Here are the steps to follow for a return/exchange: 
 

 1. Visit https://lasclay.happyreturns.com/ to obtain a return label. After entering your order number and zip code, select the products you want to return and then choose the ones you want as replacements. At the end, you will receive a prepaid return label.
 

 2. Print the label, pack the products to be returned, and affix the label to the package. Please prefer the use of envelopes/bags instead of boxes, which are more expensive.
 

 3. Drop it off in a red Canada Post box or at the nearest post office.
 

 4. Once the return is received, we will send the new product(s) and request a 9.99$ exchange fee (only if applicable) 😊
 

 Warm regards,
 __
 Laurence 
 

 Lasclay

messages.subject: Re: Order L-40271 Exchange
messages.text:
Hello Joseph,
 

 We apologize for the much longer than usual response time. We are currently receiving a higher number of inquiries than normal, but we are doing everything we can to address them quickly.
 

 We noticed that you opted for a refund since the size you wanted was not available.
 

 Your refund has been successfully processed to the Visa card ending in 2870.
 

 Depending on the processing times of your financial institution, the amount should appear in your account within a few business days.
 

 We hope this is just a temporary setback!
 

 Warm regards,
 __
 Hari 
 

 Lasclay
